I read this as an implementation request - update `executeDrop` in `TerminalSplitView.tsx` so same-tab terminal drops invoke `onSplitPane` directly while preserving browser group splits and cross-tab terminal pane movement.

### Changes Made
In `ui/src/components/TerminalSplitView.tsx`, inside `executeDrop`'s `move-tab-to-pane-split` branch:
- When the dropped tab is a terminal tab and `command.sourceTabId === command.targetTabId`, execute:
  ```ts
  onSplitPane(command.targetTabId, command.targetLeafId, command.direction, {
    position: command.position,
  });
  return true;
  ```
- Retained browser tab checks to delegate to `onMoveTabToSplit(command.sourceTabId, targetGroupId, command.direction, command.position)` without splitting panes.
- Retained cross-tab terminal tab movement delegating to `onMoveTabToSplit(..., { tabId: command.targetTabId, leafId: command.targetLeafId })`.

### Verification
1. Filtered RED test:
   `bun --cwd ui test -t "calls onSplitPane and avoids onMoveTabToSplit when dragging an active terminal tab onto an edge of its own pane" src/components/TerminalSplitView.paneDrop.runtime.test.tsx` -> **PASSED** (1 passed, 3 skipped).
2. Full suite & adjacent browser test:
   `bun --cwd ui test src/components/TerminalSplitView.paneDrop.runtime.test.tsx src/components/TerminalSplitView.browserPaneDrop.runtime.test.tsx` -> **PASSED** (5 passed across 2 files).
3. Component suite check & TypeScript build:
   `bun --cwd ui test src/components/TerminalSplitView` -> **PASSED** (32 passed across 8 files).
   `bun --cwd ui build` (`tsc && vite build`) -> **SUCCESS**.
